result:
Both scope items are built: the business-case screens with Finance validation of the baseline, and the T09 formula screens with the live builder and the two B0087 examples. They pass typecheck, build, lint, prettier and contrast (all exit 0). But `pnpm test` and the full web e2e run exit 1. Every failure is in FE-A0's seam tests, which still expect the placeholder stub on my four routes, and I'm not allowed to edit them. Nothing is committed; the changes are in the worktree for you to integrate.

**What fails, and the fix I'm proposing**
- **Unit tests:** with the locale unset and with C.UTF-8, 1267 pass and 8 fail. The 8 are FE-A0's stub checks on my four routes, in English and Arabic (`apps/web/src/app/p3-seams.test.tsx`, which is in the forbidden `app/**`).
- **Full web e2e (both locale settings):** 84 pass, 2 fail and 2 don't run, all in FE-A0's `p3-seams.spec.ts`.
- **Proposed fix:** `T-DG3-FE-C-evidence/proposed-p3-seams-fe-c.patch`. It drops my four routes from the stub checks and keeps the route-wiring checks for all twelve. It applies cleanly. A temporary copy of the patched unit test passed 26 of 26; I deleted the copy afterwards. I did not run the patched e2e spec. FE-A and FE-B will hit the same problem for their own routes.

**What passes**
- **My tests:** 40 new unit tests (half English, half Arabic) and 6 new e2e tests per language, all passing in both locale settings. The e2e runs on the real stack and includes the read-only auditor pass.
- **Existing specs:** `journeys`, `p2-journeys`, `session-end` and `p2-blank-text` still pass in both languages and both locale settings.
- **Accessibility:** 17 screens per language have 0 serious or critical axe issues.
- **DG2 validator:** `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG2` exits 0, before and after the work.

**What the screens do**
- **Business cases:**
  - The transformation case has all ten source sections. Initiative cases are lighter and link to it.
  - Each line has exactly one class, picked from a single select. The value basis is limited to what that class allows.
  - Amounts are exact decimals.
  - Gross benefits, implementation cost and net value are shown separately. Net is Unknown unless both sides are known. The transformation case rolls up its initiative cases, counting each line once.
- **Finance validation:** it is labelled "business approval" and is offered only to a Finance user who didn't author the record. The e2e confirms that a baseline edit turns a validated state into Stale, never green.
- **T09 formulas:**
  - The register has the six columns with H/M/L confidence.
  - The two examples are marked "Illustrative calculation, synthetic values" and preview 100,000 and 500,000 SAR per year.
  - The builder checks the formula as you type and marks the error position. Undefined variables and period mismatches show before saving.
  - Percentages are entered as percent and stored as fractions.
  - Versions, Finance validation per version, and recorded calculations with their inputs are all on the detail page.

**Problems the real-stack e2e caught, now fixed**
- The builder lost its "version saved" message after saving.
- The calculation section stayed on version 1 after version 2 became current.
- A fixed English label from the API showed untranslated to Arabic users. I now translate that exact string, but a code from the backend would be more robust.
- There were two accessibility failures: link contrast inside a banner, and an overflowing table.

**Other gaps**
- Archive errors use the shared archive dialog, so they show a generic (translated) message instead of the specific one.
- I didn't add the audit-trail labels for business-case and formula events, because that file isn't mine.
- No seeded user has the Finance role, so the e2e grants a synthetic Finance role to `dev.office` on its own transformation. No real approval was given.

Everything is in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG3/`: the handback is `T-DG3-FE-C-frontend-ux-engineer.md`, and the logs, screenshots and patch are in `T-DG3-FE-C-evidence/`.
